seal.statement: Make failed and successful startup terminate naturally. both successful startup and failure during joining terminate within existing bounds without SIGKILL or a new forced-exit workaround. No owned workers, subscriptions, retry loops or handles remain. Restart resumes retained obligations correctly. Coverage completion is checked separately and cannot substitute for natural exit.

text: Eliminate forced-exit and hanging-process root causes across node startup, failed joining, and shutdown lifecycles by enforcing strict owner teardown. When a node starts successfully or fails during join admission, every acquired resource—including NodeService intervals and singletons on terminal runtime unwind, LogsTableService flush timers and pending queues, CdcIntegrationService event listeners, and ControlPlaneReadinessService reconcile intervals—must be systematically unwound and released via the startup cleanup ledger and JoinCleanupHandler while retaining NodeService initialization across per-attempt join cleanup for outer retryable rejoin handoff.

Implemented systematic resource cleanup across runtime startup, joining teardown, and log persistence: (1) Added isStopped(), clearIntervals(), and idempotent shutdown to NodeService. (2) Updated LogsTableService to immediately stop new admissions on shutdown/stop, cancel pending flush timers and retry intervals with unref'd sleep handles, clear volatile pending write queues, and detach from LoggingService. (3) Enhanced JoinCleanupHandler.cleanup() to stop ControlPlaneReadinessService and its membership driver, mark and strip listeners from CdcIntegrationService, safely unwind RebalanceCoordinator, clear NodeService intervals while retaining initialized state for outer rejoin handoff, and await shutdown on LogsTableService. (4) Wired cleanupLedger unwinding in lagrange-runtime-startup so NodeService and LogsTableService singletons are shut down on terminal runtime shutdown and failed boot. (5) Authored comprehensive evidence harness and test suite covering retained-resource-cause, successful-start-natural-exit, failed-join-natural-exit, owned-resources-released, and restart-retains-committed-obligations.

Independent Argon verification of node-startup-natural-shutdown: inspected src/bootstrap/join-cleanup-handler.js, src/lagrange-runtime-startup.js, src/logging/logging-service.js, src/logging/logs-table-service-flush-helpers.js, src/logging/logs-table-service.js, src/node/node-service.js, scripts/quest-evidence/node-startup-natural-shutdown.js, test/node/node-startup-natural-shutdown.test.js, and test/test-helpers/natural-shutdown-child.js. Confirmed retained resources across startup, failed join, and normal shutdown are released through canonical owner teardown while preserving outer retryable rejoin NodeService handoff and the single-process claim contract, child processes exit naturally without forced process.exit or SIGKILL, committed durable obligations survive restart, and all static checks pass.
